name: RISC-V host QEMU startup A/B
primary_metric: process spawn to QMP greeting elapsed nanoseconds
optional_guest_metric: process spawn to guest success marker elapsed nanoseconds
optional_guest_elf_metric: process spawn to bare-metal RVWORK_DONE checksum elapsed nanoseconds
guest_gate: Optional Linux kernel plus initrd must emit QEMU_GUEST_TEST_PASS and must not emit QEMU_GUEST_TEST_FAIL on both arms.
guest_elf_gate: Optional bare-metal guest ELF must complete the RVWORK serial handshake (RVWORK_READY -> g -> RVWORK_DONE <checksum> -> e), report the expected checksum, and exit 0 on both arms.
guest_sources: Benchtest/qemu/guest/ sources with guest/build.sh; manifest feeds run.py --guest-programs
